description: Get the account's token balance and plan. Plans are sold in leads and every price is in tokens: one new lead (a business found by a search, with its website read, the emails it publishes found but not checked, its owner where one is named, and the relevance check) costs one token; a listing (the Google Maps details only) one token per five. Businesses the account already holds: enrichment is one token per five. A verified email costs 3 tokens, charged only when an address comes back verified. A named contact found on the open web costs 2 tokens, charged only when a person is found. Enrolling leads in automatic enrichment (re-read about monthly) is free within the plan's room of three months of its leads. Unused tokens roll over, up to three months' allowance. Plans are bought and changed on the Lyre Leads website, not through these tools; the result carries the link.
